name: Olesa de Bonesvalls (Spain)
description: Divided per bend sinister, the upper half yellow with the red scallop shell of the arms, the lower green, the two halves separated by a red bend sinister.
history: The official flag of Olesa de Bonesvalls is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided per bend sinister, the upper half yellow with the red scallop of the arms and the lower half green, separated by a red bend sinister of 1/5 of the height; it carries the colours of the arms, in which a green valley figures on a yellow field.

features.role: bend sinister 1/5 of the height separating the halves
scallop shell of the arms, 1/3 of the height
